raw_text: SATP Incident Report — Jharkhand LWE Attack, September 18, 2024. Location: Burha Pahar forest area, Latehar district, Jharkhand. Incident: IED attack on CRPF 209 Battalion convoy followed by small arms fire. Casualties: 4 CRPF personnel killed, 7 injured. Attribution: CPI(Maoist) Jharkhand-Bihar-Chhattisgarh Special Area Committee. Context: This is the deadliest LWE attack in Jharkhand since the 2019 Gumla ambush. The Burha Pahar corridor has seen increased Maoist activity since the April 2024 area commander rotation. Intelligence inputs from the preceding week had indicated planned action but specific location was not identified.
